verdict.rationale: Omnara's pricing page states it is "Open source under Apache 2.0" and free to self-host, the homepage brands it "the open-source alternative to Claude Managed Agents," and a public GitHub repository (omnara-ai/omnara) describes self-hosted deployments. One HN comment hints at doubts about its open-source history, but it offers no concrete counter-evidence, so it does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: direct evidence of the LICENSE file or full source tree in the repo, independent hands-on corroboration that the complete product source is published under that license.
